description: National Police Commission - National Police Commission Rules (Appeal Procedure) 2016
reasoning: The gazette content contains rules made by the National Police Commission regarding appeal procedures for police officers. This constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements established under constitutional authority, specifically falling under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" (Type 5) which includes "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation." While it involves police matters, it is primarily about establishing legal procedures rather than personnel appointments or law enforcement operations.
